machineEvidence.description: States 'over 30 CNC machines' on-site including multi-axis CNC lathes with live tooling for simultaneous operations and automated production. Specific brands/models not published.

Named equipment: '3 axis Haas machines' stated to hold tight tolerances on both large production runs and single prototype pieces. Also states 3-, 4-, and 5-axis machining centers generally, but only the Haas 3-axis line is named specifically.

States 'over 25 CNC Machining Centres,' including a full range of 3, 4, and 5-axis milling machines and CNC lathes with live tooling. This is the most specific equipment-count claim (number of machines, not just process/axis capability) found anywhere in the 13-supplier dataset. Specific brands/models not published.

Named equipment: 6kW LVD3015 Phoenix Fiber Optic Laser Cutter, with capacity for 1500mm x 3000mm sheets and cutting thickness up to 20mm steel / 16mm aluminum / 12mm copper & brass. This is a named brand/model with a quantified spec - one of the most concrete individual machine records in the dataset.
